blocks.text: Then the account turns to the Bachittar Natak testimony: the throne of Delhi was shaken when Tegh Bahadur made his departure.
Tegh Bahadur performed a deed no one else could perform; when he left, the whole world was plunged into grief while the heavens rang with victory. (55 and related lines)
Only then did Aurangzeb realize, too late, that he had failed to understand the true stature of the Guru.
